title.narrative: Capacity support for promoting peaceful coexistence through unity in diversity project
Stärkung von Initiativen für Versöhnung, Gerechtigkeit und Frieden auf diözesaner Ebene in Äthiopien

description.narrative: Ethiopia is a country beset with conflict. Between 2020 and 2022, an extremely violent civil war raged in the northern region, and war-like conditions currently prevail intwo sub-regions. Other parts of the country are also experiencing entrenched conflicts. This leads to flight, trauma and a weakening of cohesion. A training programme for key persons in three dioceses aims to disseminate peace-related messages and training through multipliers. The goal is peaceful conflict resolution, violence prevention and the establishment of peace structures in the face of the fragile situation.
